constraints: Cannot be queued; two CANCEL calls in a row from one method have the same effect as one.
In the On Printing Detail form event during Print form execution, CANCEL suspends printing of the current form and resumes it on the next page, rather than cancelling data entry.

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Cancels the current interactive context (data entry started by ADD RECORD/MODIFY RECORD, a DIALOG-displayed form, a DISPLAY SELECTION/MODIFY SELECTION, or an in-progress form print), acting like the user pressing Escape.
